trial_court: I Additional District Judge, Karimnagar (O.P.No.243 of 2010)
case_name: K Gayathri, Karimnagar Dist 1 Other vs K Bhagyalakshmi, Karimnagar Dist. 5

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: K Gayathri, son and daughter of deceased-Anjaiah through the 6th respondent

facts_of_case: Petitioners claimed to be the son and daughter of deceased-Anjaiah through the 6th respondent. The trial court dismissed their implead application.

legal_principles.principle: Even if a marriage is not lawful, the children born out of it would still be heirs-at-law.
legal_principles.held: Under Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, even if the marriage between the 6th respondent and the said Anjaiah was not a lawful marriage, the petitioners would be heirs-at-law.

legal_principles.principle: The court should not unnecessarily go into the question of whether a person is the lawfully wedded wife or husband.
legal_principles.held: The Court below overlooked this fact and unnecessarily went into the question whether the 6th respondent is the lawfully wedded wife of the deceased-Anjaiah or not.

outcome.final_order: The Court below's order dt.23.03.2017 was set aside and the petitioners' claim to be the son and daughter of deceased-Anjaiah through the 6th respondent was accepted.
